content.text:
Fixed! The issue was floating-point precision errors when converting EUR amounts to cents. When JavaScript multiplies 39.95 by 100, it produces 3995.0000000000005 instead of 3995 due to how binary floating-point numbers work.

I added `Math.round()` to three functions in the money and locale modules:
- `parseEuros` (src/money.js)
- `cellCents` (src/money.js)
- `decimalCommaToCents` (src/locale.js)

All 50 tests pass, and your command now works:
```
$ subtrack add Gym 39.95 --since 2026-10-03
Added Gym: €39.95 monthly, €39.95 a month, next charge 2026-12-03.
```

Ready to commit these changes?
